name: Abóbora
notes: Hopper. The carved holes are the key colours glow (#ffd23f) and glow_hi (#fff2a8): the runtime may brighten them at night; asleep they are hollow (unlit, eyes shut in curves). The pupils (#4a1606) and the peach blush stay. idle breathes on the shade band above the base (no face row is touched) and the candle dips once a cycle. Hops squash and stretch symmetrically and rise 4 px at the top of the hop in every direction. sit-down is settled (2 rows lower, 2 columns wider, content eyes). look-down turns the whole face and the stem. Extra clip: blink-down (1 frame, eyes to slits).
